title: The Blue Hour of the old quarter
author: Kestrel Okonkwo
blurb: Ivo Halloran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
